$comment: Update manifest — host at repo root on the main branch. Fetched via raw.githubusercontent.com. Update this file as part of every release; the app falls back to the GitHub Releases API if this file is unreachable.

notes.en: Added update checks with startup detection, title-bar notifications, and options to skip a version or be reminded later. Updates now follow the installation channel: Microsoft Store builds open the Store, Windows installer builds download the matching installer, and About displays the current channel.
